decomposition.title: Pokémon Chess
decomposition.premise: A strategic game combining the classic gameplay of chess with Pokémon characters and their unique abilities. Players command Pokémon as chess pieces, each with special moves influencing the board state.

mechanics.description: Players alternate turns moving their chess pieces on the board according to chess movement rules.
Each Pokémon piece has special abilities or moves that can alter normal chess mechanics or affect other pieces.
Certain Pokémon types have advantages or disadvantages against others, influencing captures or defenses.
